title: Concept: npm auth token stored in the client file
description: .npmrc declares a literal `_authToken` value, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A secret committed in this file is readable by everyone with repository access and lives on in history after removal. This rule reads a literal `_authToken` value.
risk: A secret committed in this file is readable by everyone with repository access and lives on in history after removal. This rule reads a literal `_authToken` value.
